While the other four assets (72151, 72152, 72153, and the collection image) represent valid on-campaign LEGO® Pokémon™ products from the February 2026 launch wave, the missing product name violates the deterministic SKU pre-check requirement and creates ambiguity about whether this is a distinct retail asset or a duplicate composite. Additionally, only 4 properly identified product assets exist when 3–5 are required. The logo asset is valid but cannot compensate for product asset deficiencies. The LEGO® official wordmark logo is correctly presented. The asset shows the iconic LEGO brick-style wordmark with proper brand colors (red background #E3000B, yellow outline #FFED00, white fill, black stroke) and the registered trademark symbol. This is a valid official LEGO Group wordmark suitable for the LEGO® Pokémon™ collaboration campaign.
